marks.gloss_en: Rav Chisda: this is one whose house is empty of sin
ומנין... שנאמר: קומו ברכו את ה' אלהיכם מן העולם עד העולם
תלמוד לומר: ומרומם על כל ברכה ותהלה -- על כל ברכה תן לו תהלה

and from where that one does not answer amen in the Temple? as it says: 'stand up and bless the Lord your God from the world to the world, and let them bless Your glorious name, exalted above every blessing and praise' (Neh 9:5)
ומנין... שנאמר: קומו ברכו... ומרומם על כל ברכה ותהלה
but in the Temple they would say 'Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from the world to the world; Blessed... Redeemer of Israel', and they did not answer amen after him
and they answer amen after him [after each blessing]
כדתניא: בגואל ישראל מאריך -- the baraita has him lengthen goel yisrael
when was this said? in the outlying places; but in the Temple it is not so
then in the Temple what does he say? 'Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from the world to the world; Blessed... Redeemer of Israel'
and he resumes: He Who answered Abraham on Mount Moriah, He will answer you and hear the sound of your cry this day
and so R' Chalafta instituted in Tzippori
he says before them twenty-four blessings: the eighteen of every day, and he adds six more
what is 'she has uttered her voice against me' (Jer 12:8)? this is an unworthy prayer leader who goes down before the ark
הני שש? שבע הוויין! כדתנן: על השביעית הוא אומר ברוך המרחם על הארץ -- the mishnah itself speaks of a seventh, so the additions are seven, not six
מאי שביעית -- שביעית לארוכה: 'the seventh' is the seventh for length (= p_shviit_laarucha)
and he says before them twenty-four blessings: the eighteen of every day, and he adds to them six more
and he resumes and says: He Who answered our fathers at the Red Sea, He will answer you and hear the sound of your cry this day
מאי טעמא דרבי יהודה -- לפי שאין אומרים זכרונות ושופרות אלא בראש השנה וביובלות ובשעת מלחמה
R' Yehuda says: [the prayer leader] did not need to say Zichronot [and Shofarot]
for the first he says: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting, blessed is the Redeemer of Israel
and the chazzan of the assembly says: Sound the terua, sons of Aaron, sound the terua
